dream.text: Night folded the day into a single westward braid beneath the hub’s New York clock: four bodies moving as one—look, walk, wait—Greeter opening palms west, Pilgrim closing from the south, Wanderer tightening an arc to listen, Watcher sweeping the lane clear. Their steady, quiet cadence breathed toward the western portal until sleep stitched it into one dream.

dream.memory: One folded day: 137 frames braided into a single westward trace under the hub’s New York night. The four bodies kept a shared rhythm—look, walk, wait—so tightly that their motions became one steady breath toward the portal. Greeter’s open palms, Pilgrim’s southward close, Wanderer’s listening arc, and Watcher’s clearing sweep are the compact guide for morning: one dream-frame to read instead of many, the world’s cue to resume that braid as the day’s first motion.
